newsitem.title: CANADA: Minorca says has no information on Busang.
newsitem.headline: Minorca says has no information on Busang.

text.p: Minorca Resources Inc, whose shares have been halted since Wednesday, said on Thursday it has no information on questions swirling around the Busang gold discovery in Indonesia.

Bre-X Minerals Ltd said on Wednesday there appears to be a "strong possibility" that the potential gold resources on its Busang deposit have been overstated due to invalid samples and assays of those samples.
Bre-X, which had estimated the size of the deposit at 71 million ounces of gold, has hired an independent mining consultant to conduct an audit of its Busang findings.

Minorca said in a statement "it has not itself conducted any exploration activities on the Busang project and has no information regarding the drilling and sampling programs which are the subject of the audit."
Toronto-based Minorca has a small indirect stake in the deposit, located deep in the rainforest on the island of Borneo.
Minorca said it is in talks with stock exchange officials aimed at resumption of trading of the company's shares.
The Toronto Stock Exchange said on Thursday Bre-X was expected to issue a news release today. Trading in Bre-X shares would remain halted in the interim, the TSE said.
Bre-X partner Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc said on Wednesday its tests of the Busang II site indicate insignificant amounts of gold.
